(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a __medical element selected from the group consisting of an instrument and a medicament__ into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1, further comprising __inserting the elongated device into the brain, not between tissue layers__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; __reinforcing the device against the tissue to maintain the working channel__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device __without restriction to a specific tissue layer__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
